prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for Godot xianxia game. Input image 1 is the ACCEPTED Qingheng E design and identity reference. Create one polished standalone full body portrait of EXACTLY this adult woman, apparent age 25+, same blue eyes, navy long partly pinned hair, white-blue flower and gold hair ornaments, high blue collar, blue fitted bodice, white/sky-blue layered hanfu skirt with bamboo print, detachable flowing sleeves, jade waist pendant, embroidered blue shoes. Preserve face, refined anime painting and scholarly warmth. She holds closed navy book against torso with left hand and writing brush near face with right hand. Preserve appealing elegant mature proportions. Fit ALL hair, sleeves, ribbons, skirt, shoes inside frame with generous clear margin on every side, simplify outer hair sweep slightly to avoid edge tangencies. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Character only: NO bamboo background, NO floating leaves, NO floor, NO shadow plate, NO atmosphere, NO text, NO UI, NO checkerboard painted into image. Fine clean anti-aliased hair edges, opaque white costume, translucent fabric only where intentional. Single coherent illustration, not a sheet.
